changeSet.author: xiezm
changeSet.comment: F13-T09: the platform default quality gate is ADVISORY. Only the untouched migration seed (revision 1, last modified by system-migration) is moved from BLOCKING to ADVISORY; a value set by a person is kept. The system never switches the gate to BLOCKING by itself.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO modeling_platform_governance_policy ( policy_key, standard_coverage, quality_gate, revision, created_by, last_modified_by, created_date, last_modified_date ) SELECT 'PLATFORM_DEFAULT', 'KEY_AND_MEASURE', 'ADVISORY', 1, 'system-migration', 'system-migration', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM modeling_platform_governance_policy WHERE policy_key = 'PLATFORM_DEFAULT' ); UPDATE modeling_platform_governance_policy SET quality_gate = 'ADVISORY', last_modified_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE policy_key = 'PLATFORM_DEFAULT' AND quality_gate = 'BLOCKING' AND revision = 1 AND last_modified_by = 'system-migration';
